answer: Each identity gets two invites, and every invite splits its audit across three reviewers from different pools, so a self-vote counts 0. Reviewers whose pool overlaps the recruit's are dropped. A 500-identity farm then needs 1,500 reviewer slots it cannot self-supply; the mirror of its own accounts shows up as overlap and voids 100% of votes. Invites flow down a river of two per node, and the voyage stops at depth three.
